entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. For technical support, press two. To speak with a representative, please stay on the line.
REPRESENTATIVE! This is ridiculous, get me a person now!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit support, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. I'm looking at my order and it says I received it 16 days ago, and your system won't let me return it. This is completely unacceptable!
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones, order number 8-6-7-5-3-0-9. And don't give me the runaround about your policy. This is your company's fault.
Thank you, Sam. I see your account here. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference issue?

It's an issue with your company! I tried to return this thing a week ago, on day nine, well within your ridiculous 10-day window. Your entire website was down! I demand a full refund right now, or you can put me through to your manager. I'm a VIP member and I will blast this all over the internet.
I completely understand your frustration, and I want to resolve this for you. You mentioned you tried to initiate the return last week and experienced a website error?

Yes! A 'website error' is putting it mildly. The entire return portal was a joke. I have a screenshot of the error page. I couldn't print the label because the whole system was down. This is on you, not me.

Thank you for that detail, Sam. That's very helpful. Let me just check our system status logs for that period... and yes, I am seeing it now. We had a documented server outage that day that impacted the customer portal. I sincerely apologize that you were affected by that.
So you admit it. Now, what are you going to do about it? Are you authorized to give me my money back, or am I wasting my time with you?

I can absolutely resolve this for you right now. Since you attempted the return within the correct timeframe and were blocked by our system being down, I'm processing an exception for a full refund. You did everything right, and I'm sorry our system failed you.
About time. And I'm not paying a dime for shipping to send it back.

Of course not. A pre-paid return label is on its way to your email right now. And listen, for the trouble this has caused, and as a thank you for being a VIP customer, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account. You can use that on any future purchase.
Oh. A full refund and a fifty dollar credit? Okay. That's... that's actually good service. Thank you. I was ready for a fight, but you handled it.
I'm very glad I could turn this around for you, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Just make sure that email comes through.
It's already been sent. You should see it in the next few minutes. Thank you again for calling VeloFit, and we appreciate your business.
